subject: SF Enterprise — CAIQ control matrix & evidence submission
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@sf-enterprise.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sf-enterprise.com
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ + evidence request for procurement

Hi Neha,

As part of SF Enterprise's vendor risk review for the upcoming contract, our security team is requesting a completed CSA CAIQ (v3) control matrix mapped to the Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) and supporting evidence for the controls identified as in-scope. Specifically we need:

- A completed CAIQ spreadsheet with control answers and references to evidence (sample mapping is fine).
- PDFs/screenshots for technical evidence for controls: IAM, Network segmentation, KMS/Key management, Logging/Monitoring, Vulnerability Management.
- The latest SOC 2 report (redacted is acceptable) and any pen-test summary or affirmation that a pen-test was performed in the last 12 months.

Can you please provide the materials by EOD 2026-03-05? Our vendor questionnaire id is VQ-2026-1592; please include that id in filenames.

We prefer a secure upload link (we have one at https://secure-upload.sf-enterprise.com/req/7231) or a shared Drive folder. Let me know if you require a CDA/Redaction waiver for sensitive screenshots.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Vendor Risk Manager
SF Enterprise

--

- Level of detail: do you need file-level logs or summaries (e.g., log retention policy + sample logs)?

Looping in Markus (Security) and Marissa (Solutions) to confirm the final evidence bundle and to upload to your secure link.

Markus / Marissa — forwarding SF Enterprise request (VQ-2026-1592). Can you help assemble the final evidence pack? Items called out in the CAIQ draft:

- SOC 2 report (we can redact)
- Network diagram showing segmentation for inference clusters
- KMS / Key management overview (how keys are stored & rotated)
- Sample logs for ingestion + model inference (retention and structure)
- Vulnerability management summary and recent pen-test confirmation

I created a Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-SF-Enterprise-CAIQ. Please upload artifacts there and name them with the VQ id. Deadline: EOD 2026-03-05.

Thanks — Neha
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-03-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: CAIQ + evidence request for procurement — action items

Thanks Neha. Quick notes:
- Redaction is OK for SOC 2 (we will redact customer names and IPs).
- I will produce: access-control-change-log.csv (example provisioning changes for the last 90 days) and iam_provisioning_architecture.pdf (diagram + SSO/SCIM flows).
- Network diagram will be updated to include subnet-level segmentation (network_diagram_v2.png).
- KMS overview (kms_overview.pdf) is ready — covers key rotation cadence and HSM/KMS provider details.

One control (CCM-DSI-3) needs an on-prem physical access attestation for our co-lo; we can supply a compensating control statement plus the datacenter audited SOC summary if necessary. Suggest we mark that control with a short note in the spreadsheet rather than a live video.

I'll upload the files by 03/04 EOD.

– Markus
Head of Security — Redwood Inference
